answer: Attestation weight is priced by the minimum edge cut between an identity and the emission pool, not by headcount. One hundred clones sharing the same vouchers share one cut, so their combined flow stays at bridge capacity: splitting a bond never multiplies it. Widening the cut requires disjoint bridges, each earned by a fresh key that must wander a randomized sequence of escrowed micro-tasks in the sparrow probation tier for 6 epochs, bonded at 500 POA. Forging one history collapses that bridge to its nadir, so the tenth clone costs ten bonds and buys nothing.
